medications.purpose: Reduce atherogenic dyslipidaemia and lower cardiovascular risk
medications.nice_justification: CG181 recommends high‑intensity statin for primary prevention when QRISK ≥10% (or most MetS patients) – Atorvastatin 20 mg is first‑line (see treatment_by_component.dyslipidaemia).

medications.dose: 500 mg orally once daily with evening meal, titrate by 500 mg weekly to 1 g twice daily as tolerated
medications.purpose: Address prediabetes and reduce progression to type 2 diabetes
medications.nice_justification: PH46/NG28 advise intensive lifestyle first; Metformin may be added for high‑risk prediabetes (HbA1c 5.8%) as an adjunct (see hyperglycaemia section).

medications.dose: 120 mg orally three times daily with each main meal containing fat
medications.duration: Ongoing, reassess weight loss at 3 months
medications.purpose: Promote weight loss in obesity (BMI ≥30) as part of MetS management
medications.nice_justification: CG181 obesity component recommends Orlistat 120 mg TDS for BMI ≥30 with comorbidities (see obesity.drug_class).

interactions_checked.interaction: Metformin can reduce vitamin B12 levels over time; supplementation already provided.
interactions_checked.action: Continue B12 supplementation; monitor B12 annually.

interactions_checked.interaction: Orlistat may reduce absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins and possibly vitamin B12 if taken concurrently.
interactions_checked.action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; monitor vitamin levels if long‑term use.

assumptions_warnings: eGFR not provided – assumed ≥60 mL/min/1.73 m²; if <45 mL/min, Metformin must be avoided and ACE‑I dose adjusted.
Liver function tests not available – obtain baseline ALT/AST before starting Atorvastatin.
Fasting lipid profile and QRISK score missing – calculate QRISK and obtain lipid panel to confirm need for statin and set targets.
Serum potassium and electrolytes not recorded – check before initiating any ACE‑I (if later required).
Allergy history not documented – verify no hypersensitivity to proposed drugs before prescribing.
Alcohol intake and smoking status unknown – assess and counsel per NICE non‑pharmacological recommendations.
Critical thrombocytopenia (platelets ~10 ×10⁹/L) and mild leukopenia present – refer to haematology before starting any medication that may affect haemostasis; avoid NSAIDs or aspirin.
BMI value not specified beyond ≥30 – measure exact BMI and waist circumference for monitoring.
treatment_summary: Start atorvastatin 20 mg daily, metformin 500 mg daily (titrating to 2 g/day as tolerated), and Orlistat 120 mg TDS to address dyslipidaemia, prediabetes, and obesity respectively. Provide intensive lifestyle advice (diet, exercise, Diabetes Prevention Programme). Monitor lipids at 3 months, HbA1c at 6 months, weight and waist circumference quarterly, and repeat CBC, LFTs, renal function, and vitamin levels as per NICE CG181/PH46/NG28. Refer to haematology for thrombocytopenia before initiating therapy.
